items.name: Genshin Impact: Fatui Series Chibi
items.note: I love collecting these adorable Fatui chibis, especially when they feature two of my favorites, Tartaglia and Wanderer!

items.name: Genshin Impact: Vision Keychain
items.note: This little keychain lets me carry a piece of Teyvat with me wherever I go! It’s a cute, subtle way to show my love for Genshin and my favorite adventures.

items.name: Genshin Impact: Academy's Light and Shadow
items.note: Look at the adorable chibi designs and beautiful details, and getting Kinich and Xiao made these figures even more special!

items.name: FIFINE AmpliTank K688CT Podcast Microphone Kit
items.note: Crisp, clear audio that keeps my voice sounding professional and makes streaming a breeze!

items.name: FIFINE SC8 Gaming Audio Mixer for Live Streaming with 7.1ch Surround sound
items.note: Makes managing my stream audio so easy, with handy controls, fun effects, and immersive surround sound!

items.name: VSD N4 Pro Stream Controller Streaming Deck, Audio and Studio Controller
items.note: Makes streaming so much easier with customizable shortcuts, quick controls, and a sleek setup that keeps everything at my fingertips!
